scope: First-pass per-file classification after T2.4. This is a review index and pending scenario list, not a gate, hash witness, Minecraft result or completed P3/P4 acceptance.

scenarios: Place, light, insert three skewers, oil, flip four times, season and extract through real module imports.
Preserve original items and metadata on hand/storage/output failure; refuse stale hand or replaced block.
Burnout, destruction, full inventory and reload must not pay an output twice.
Main/offhand insert, take and place preserve complete item metadata; post-write rejection restores owned values.
Full plate break produces one packed item; early/late/unreadable explosion cancellation and replaced blocks retain contents.
Unknown drop/rollback results stay quarantined across reload; acknowledged delivery only finishes cleanup and never reissues items.
Record, convert, place and retrieve recipe books with full inventories, native slot movement, support loss and foreign concurrent changes.
Main/offhand bucket stacks keep exact remainder; full inventory produces one spill; creative does not mint an extra output.
Press completion waits ten ticks, resumes after chunk unload and restores cakes/oil/residue on rejected output.
Deferred placement/hammer/break rejects stale hand, same-type replacement and cancellation; competing users retain each owner.
Unknown delivery or rollback stays quarantined after reload; registry/cache and retry work cannot retain a failed source.
Author oil placement must preserve captured quantity, reject unknown legacy quantity and honor other registered oil containers.
Click every rack slot and facing; preserve exact item metadata for deposit, withdrawal, partial merge, hotbar swap and automation return.
Destination/source/filter faults restore earlier writes; ambiguous rollback quarantines and blocks replay.
Reject stale main/offhand, changed selected slot, changed facing/owner and cancelled/replaced explosion targets.
Crosshair versus direct-touch targeting selects the intended slot; display masks remain derived from unchanged native storage.
New heat uses Java buckets while existing saved deadlines remain precise; expiration and Cookery configuration do not rewrite unrelated metadata.
Keep all foreign RawMessage lore at the 20-line boundary; reject corrupt carriers and post-write/readback failures without losing prior heat.
Food and returned containers retain seasoning, quality, effects and oil type across takeout, destruction and reload.
Native author input admission, capacity and completion duration require supported host/engine integration, not source-evaluated callbacks.
Main/offhand use, release at the Java minimum, native completion and shorter-profile completion settle exactly one serving.
Switch hands/items, disconnect, repeat eating and foreign metadata changes must not debit or reward the wrong stack.
Raw/failed/secret/alternate-profile ingredients preserve effects and returned containers; malformed or missing secret records reject use.
Verify the native consumption-cancels-use spike before replacing shadow IDs; client animation timing and other eating packs remain staging work.
Refresh only owned ingredient/maxim/heat lines, preserve foreign structured messages and stackable metadata tokens.
Native setter rejection, silent no-op, wrong readback and unavailable property enumeration must prevent a lossy commit.
a2769: foreign/raw items unchanged, maxim update idempotent, duplicate owned lines removed, full 20-line lore preserved and heat filtering leaves foreign text intact.
Native/custom hot effects merge against the correct start snapshot, including expiration during eating.
Damage, invincibility, ordinary shield and heavy-metal deferral settle once under reentrant or rejected callbacks.
Sound/particle failures remain cosmetic; native Molang velocity, cooldown and entity lifetime require engine validation.
Reserve and release dodge destinations, including failed movement, replaced owner and concurrent claims.
Respect ground/liquid/collision boundaries and move/audio failures through the actual event adapter.
Harvest and replant preserve drops, seeds and crop state under write failure, cancellation and concurrent gestures.
Pepper contact/worldgen budgets avoid duplicate effects or missed eligible blocks; fertilizer storage survives reload.
Village/fortress acquisition probabilities and plantable outputs must use Java data, not obsolete version-plan hashes.
Award 25 XP only after acknowledged ownership; existing completion and nested triggers cannot pay twice.
Rejected or unknown XP/claim/completion writes preserve pending recovery across reload; no command fallback repeats uncertain XP.
Register only supported author capabilities/items, keep foreign registrants independent and reject conflicts.
Native author board/oil/millstone callbacks, inventory gates, host metadata and source-only fallback need actual supported integration.
Retirement of check_cookery162_host.py is not completion of T1.10 official-vs-server package comparison.

scenarios: Review Java reference and Bedrock result for held, placed, first/third-person and eating surfaces using native state mechanisms.
Bottle fill, brush/rack tools, secret/failure ingredient order, slime clock and HUD must be checked in the real renderer.
